checks.details: NEAR AI z-ai/glm-5.3-flash: weighted total 87 vs threshold 70

scores.rationale: The checklist explicitly covers all six required topics—function-call keys, allowance limits, method restrictions, removing full-access keys, sub-account creation/deletion, and key rotation—plus useful extras like monitoring and testnet testing.

Every item includes concrete near-cli-rs commands or near-api-js calls with a stated risk, but several snippets are inaccurate or non-functional (e.g., `near keys set-allowance`, `account.updateAccount({allowance})`, `getAccountDetails().transactions`, and the malformed contract-call example), reduc

The numbered checklist with per-item titles, rationales, and official NEAR doc links is clear and well-organized, though the JSON payload is truncated to only five items and lacks a distinct summary section.
